proposal.summary: The report shows SQL injection vulnerabilities in CentOS Web Panel (v6 - v7) at admin/loader_ajax.php via the 'term' parameter (action=searchIn), demonstrated with both error-based and time-based payloads.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the vulnerability by reproducing the provided payloads against a test instance, identify all affected endpoints and parameter sanitization flaws, and implement parameterized queries or proper input sanitization; prepare coordinated disclosure with the vendor.
